_comment: v1.11.3 - the second De Bello Gallico batch: Book III (3), Book IV (5) and a Book VI top-up (2). Book III and Book IV close at their allocation; Book VI goes from 2 to 4 of its 6, and its last two travel with the Book V batch. One span crosses a chapter boundary (IV.14-15). Watch for: `decrevat` for `decreverat` at IV.17 (a source typo, emended), the spaced opening quotes at IV.25 (source style, reconciled with a `fix` that normalise() already cancels), and the editorial supplements `[hae]` and `[saevire ventus coepisset et]` at III.13, printed as the source prints them.
bg.3.13: Namque ipsorum naves ad hunc modum
bg.4.5: His de rebus Caesar certior factus et infirmitatem
bg.4.17: Caesar his de causis quas commemoravi
bg.4.25: Quod ubi Caesar animadvertit, naves longas
bg.4.33: Genus hoc est ex essedis pugnae.
bg.6.16: Natio est omnis Gallorum admodum dedita
bg.6.21: Germani multum ab hac consuetudine differunt.
